_comment: The opening film's voice-over. Separate from script-keuken.json because it belongs to no room — VoiceBank loads every bundled script-*.json, so a new room or scene is a new file here rather than an edit to an existing one. Same format, same rules.

_line_ids._comment: All three play over the film, chained, starting about half a second in — two over the exterior shot and the third over the cut inside. One variant each on purpose: an opening should sound the same every time, the way a title card does. The film is silent, so this is all she hears.
_line_ids.luna.intro.welkom: Over the opening shot of the bakery.
_line_ids.luna.intro.binnen: As the camera reaches the door.
_line_ids.luna.intro.keuken: Over the second shot, inside the kitchen.

variants.text: Dit is jouw bakkerij, Nina. Kom je mee naar binnen?
Kijk, de keuken! Hier bakken we de allerlekkerste taarten.
